subject: Kestrel Health — Procurement onboarding kickoff and security evidence
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Kestrel Health — Procurement onboarding kickoff and security evidence

Hi Claire,

Welcome — happy to kick off procurement onboarding for Kestrel Health. To keep contracting on schedule, our procurement team needs a short package of security and vendor setup artifacts before we can finalize PO and MSA execution. Could you please share the following items?

- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is OK) or SOC 2 letter of attestation
- ISO 27001 certificate (if applicable) and scope statement
- Penetration test attestation or executive summary (last 12 months preferred)
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached)
- Signed Data Processing Addendum (we can provide a template)
- W-9 (for US vendor setup) and remittance/billing address

We’ve attached our vendor onboarding form to speed things up (redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx). If any of these are not available, a short note on timing helps (e.g., SOC 2 in progress, expected Q3).

High level timeline we’re aiming for: once we have the artifacts + completed form, Finance will issue a vendor record and Legal will circulate the standard MSA (DocuSign) for signature. Then Kestrel can issue the PO referencing deal KL-4592 and we’ll start provisioning Dedicated capacity.

Could you confirm a target date for these items? If helpful, I’m happy to schedule a 30-min kickoff with Finance and Legal on our side.

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Procurement Program Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx]

From: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Torres <mike.torres@kestrelhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kestrel Health — Procurement onboarding kickoff and security evidence

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear list. We can provide most items this week. Attached are:

- SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf (summary redacted; full report available under NDA)
- ISO27001_certificate.pdf
- pen_test_attestation.pdf

Notes: our full SOC 2 report requires an NDA — if you can send a quick one we can provide it. Pen test attestation is an executive summary only; vendor performs annual testing and full report lives with our security portal.

On the procurement side: we don’t have a standard PII on the PO beyond billing address. Can you confirm the exact billing contact and address Redwood needs for your AP team? Also please confirm if Redwood requires a purchase order number to be present on invoices, and whether you accept ACH/wire.

We aim to get the onboarding form back by EOD Friday. Let me know if you want me to loop in our Legal/Procurement to an intro call.

Regards,
Claire Johnson
Head of Vendor Relations
Kestrel Health
[Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf; ISO27001_certificate.pdf; pen_test_attestation.pdf]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T09:38:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Kestrel Health — Procurement onboarding kickoff and security evidence

Team — forwarding Claire's package. Quick asks so we can respond:

1) Finance (Laura) — can you confirm required fields for PO and vendor setup for a US customer? Specifics: billing name (Kestrel Health Inc.), billing address, tax forms (we need W-9 from them), whether we require PO to include KL-4592 in the description, and preferred payment methods (ACH/wire).

2) Legal (Rishi) — Claire mentioned SOC 2 is available under NDA. Do we have an NDA template we prefer to use, or should I request the redacted version only? Also confirm typical MSA turnaround — we’ll send the standard MSA and ask for any redlines via DocuSign.

3) Sales Ops (Dev) — please confirm deal tagging and whether provider hosting region needs to be called out on the PO (Kestrel requested clarification).

I’d like to reply to Claire with a single consolidated note once we’ve confirmed.

Thanks — Soojin
Procurement Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kestrel Health — Procurement onboarding kickoff and security evidence

Hi Claire — thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the documents. We have everything we need to move forward with vendor setup and initial contracting. Next steps on our side:

- Legal (Rishi) will prepare the standard MSA and push via DocuSign for Kestrel review; we will request any redlines be tracked in the DocuSign comments.
- Finance (Laura) will create the vendor record once we receive the completed onboarding form and Kestrel's W-9; please send the W-9 to ap@redwoodinference.com.
- Procurement (me) will accept a PO referencing KL-4592. Please include the PO number on invoices. We accept ACH and wire; Laura will send wire instructions after vendor setup.

For convenience I uploaded our procurement packet and the draft DPA to a shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bRedwoodProcurement-KL4592. I also opened a DocuSign envelope for the MSA: https://app.docusign.com/envelopes/0a1b-Redwood-MSA-KL4592.

If SOC 2 full report is required by your security team, we can provide it under our standard NDA; otherwise the redacted summary you provided is sufficient for procurement.

Please confirm:
- Target date to return the completed onboarding form and W-9 (we’ll aim to have vendor setup within 3 business days of those items).
- Whether your Legal prefers we send the MSA first or receive a draft from Kestrel.

Thanks again — copied Laura and Rishi to keep momentum.

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
Procurement Program Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Procurement_Packet_v1.pdf]
